page: UpCloud GPU-24xCPU-240GB-1xB200 is a GPU-accelerated server configured with an Intel Xeon 8570 processor. This x86_64 architecture CPU provides 24 physical cores and 24 vCPUs running at 2.0 GHz with a shared allocation model. The system is equipped with 240.0 GB of system memory, yielding 10.0 GB per core. Acceleration is driven by a single NVIDIA Blackwell B200 GPU featuring 192 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage is not bundled with this instance, meaning external storage solutions must be attached.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong capabilities across multiple vectors. The server achieves a Passmark CPU score of 52754.5 and shows strong memory bandwidth, reaching 251.17 GB/sec for large-block read operations and 115.78 GB/sec for write operations. In LLM inference tests using a small 135M model, the system delivers top-tier performance, processing 9953.26 tokens per second for prompts and generating 525.92 tokens per second. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance via stress-ng falls within the average range, while database operations and static web serving throughput are rated as strong.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this server represents a high-density hardware class that pairs a premium Blackwell-generation GPU with a substantial system memory footprint. The lack of local storage is a notable tradeoff, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data. This configuration is highly optimized for workloads such as large language model inference, deep learning training, data science pipelines, and high-performance computing tasks that require massive VRAM and system memory.

The server is anchored by a single NVIDIA Blackwell B200 GPU with 192 GB of VRAM, though it lacks local storage. Running on the KVM hypervisor, its x86_64 architecture delivers strong memory bandwidth and top-tier LLM inference speeds, processing 9953.26 tokens per second for prompt processing on a small model. While CPU-only benchmarks like stress-ng show average performance, its massive VRAM and system memory density make it highly efficient for memory-intensive GPU workloads. This server is best suited for AI/ML training, large language model inference, and complex data science computations.
